    4: =====================================================================
    5: Does K_FIRAS := 2.035 * mu_FIRAS / mu(K=2.035) equal S_IC^cap = 3.556e5
    6: as a structural identity, or is the L_max=5 coincidence at 3.43%
    7: a numerical coincidence that fails to tighten under L_max scan?

   13:

   15:   K_FIRAS and S_IC^cap are two independently motivated scales in the
   16:   K-corridor.  K_FIRAS is set by: (i) the CMB mu-distortion FIRAS bound,
   17:   (ii) the framework-predicted mu(K=2.035), (iii) linear K-dependence of
   18:   mu(K) (gamma=1 exact under S82 W2-4 matched-IC).  S_IC^cap is set by
   19:   energy conservation at the fold: total Parker-mode energy divided by
   20:   N_modes * omega_soft gives the B3 saturation cap.
   21: 
   22:   If these land at 3.68e5 vs 3.56e5 (3.43% residual at L_max=5), two

   24:     (a) STRUCTURAL IDENTITY: residual is a truncation signature that

   26:         identity K_FIRAS = S_IC^cap would follow as a new Volovik-style
   27:         vacuum-energy/saturation-cap correspondence.

   29:         reflecting the fact that K_FIRAS and S_IC^cap share only the
   30:         K-scale parameter and are otherwise derivatively uncoupled.
